headline.title: 8 Gemini tips for organizing your space (and life)
headline.summary: The article provides eight practical tips for utilizing Gemini to enhance organization in both physical spaces and daily life. It emphasizes the use of digital tools, such as checklists and document management, to streamline tasks and improve productivity.

articles.title: AI-Designed Drugs by a DeepMind Spinoff Are Headed to Human Trials
articles.summary: Isomorphic Labs, a spinoff from DeepMind, announced that it has developed a range of AI-designed drugs that are set to enter human trials. The company's president, Max Jaderberg, highlighted the promising potential of their diverse pipeline of new medicines during a presentation at WIRED Health in London.

articles.title: AirPods, Touch Bars, and the rest of Tim Cook’s legacy
articles.summary: Tim Cook's impending departure as Apple's CEO has sparked discussions about his legacy, which includes innovations like AirPods and Touch Bars. John Ternus is widely considered his likely successor, and this transition may bring significant changes to the company.

articles.title: Apple's Next CEO Needs to Launch a Killer AI Product
articles.summary: As Apple prepares for a leadership transition, the next CEO, John Ternus, faces the critical challenge of developing a standout AI product, a task that has eluded Tim Cook during his tenure. The article emphasizes the importance of AI innovation for Apple's future growth and competitiveness.

articles.title: Musk vs. Altman is here, and it’s going to get messy
articles.summary: Elon Musk has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, claiming he was defrauded after leaving the organization he co-founded, with a trial set to begin on April 27th in Oakland, California. The case highlights ongoing tensions between Musk and current OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

articles.title: 5 Reasons to Think Twice Before Using ChatGPT—or Any Chatbot—for Financial Advice
articles.summary: The article outlines five key reasons to be cautious when seeking financial advice from AI chatbots like ChatGPT, emphasizing the importance of skepticism in their use. It highlights potential limitations and risks associated with relying on automated systems for financial guidance.

articles.title: How Project Maven taught the military to love AI
articles.summary: The US military's recent assault on Iran utilized AI systems, particularly the Maven Smart, to strike over 1,000 targets within the first 24 hours, nearly doubling the scale of previous military operations. This rapid targeting capability highlights the increasing integration of AI technology in military strategies.

articles.title: China’s DeepSeek previews new AI model a year after jolting US rivals
articles.summary: Chinese AI company DeepSeek has unveiled a preview of its next-generation AI model, V4, which it claims can compete with leading US systems from companies like Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI. The new open-source model reportedly shows significant advancements, particularly in coding capabilities.

articles.title: Prestigious photo contest answers ‘what is a photo?’
articles.summary: The World Press Photo competition continues to explore the definition of photography in the age of generative AI, emphasizing the importance of capturing reality in photojournalism. The 2026 winning entry, titled "Separated by ICE," exemplifies this focus on authentic representation.

articles.title: These AI Thirst Trap Creators Say They’re Misunderstood
articles.summary: A recent viral moment featuring AI-generated influencers has highlighted the growing trend of digital thirst trap creators on social media. These virtual personalities are gaining popularity among followers, who often overlook their artificial nature in favor of their appealing aesthetics.

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4: a million-token context that agents can actually use
articles.summary: DeepSeek-V4 introduces a million-token context capability, allowing AI agents to process and utilize extensive information more effectively. This advancement enhances the ability of AI systems to manage larger datasets and improve their performance in complex tasks.

articles.title: AI to Learn 2.0: A Deliverable-Oriented Governance Framework and Maturity Rubric for Opaque AI in Learning-Intensive Domains
articles.summary: The paper introduces a governance framework and maturity rubric aimed at addressing the challenges posed by generative AI in learning-intensive domains, particularly focusing on the issue of proxy failure where AI-generated outputs may not accurately reflect human understanding or capabilities. It emphasizes the need for effective evaluation criteria to ensure that AI-assisted outputs are credible and serve their intended educational purposes.
